transcribed_by: manual transcription of the coordinate tables printed on the source map
transcription_note: Every coordinate below is read verbatim from the four tables printed in the map legend. No coordinate is interpolated, estimated from pixel position, or invented. An object that the source does not give a coordinate for is not listed.

coordinate_frame.axes: X to the right of the printed map, Y up the printed map, H local height
coordinate_frame.origin: S1, which the source table gives as X=0, Y=0, H=0
coordinate_frame.table_column_order: the source tables print Y before X; this document stores them named, not positional
coordinate_frame.geodetic_note: The source map provides no datum, no projection and no georeferencing. Any WGS84 or Mars-body-fixed transformation would be an invention and is therefore absent.

object_types.STARTING_LOCATION: A permitted rover start/finish position defined by the organiser. NOT a scientific target.
object_types.LANDMARK: A surveyed physical landmark on the yard. A candidate observation location.
object_types.NAVIGATION_WAYPOINT: A surveyed waypoint used for the Navigation task. A candidate observation location.
object_types.DEEP_SAMPLING_LOCATION: The organiser-defined deep sampling point. Belongs to the Deep Sampling sub-task, NOT to Scientific Exploration.

zone_source.note: The zoning figure marks numbered circles 1-9 that correspond to the nine starting locations S1-S9. Zone polygons are drawn but their vertices are not given numerically, so no polygon geometry is stored. Only the per-start-location zone association that the figure states in words is recorded.

image_registration.purpose: Annotation overlay only. This transform is NEVER used to derive or refine a coordinate - every coordinate above comes from the printed tables.
image_registration.equation: px_x = origin_px[0] + scale_px_per_m * x_m ; px_y = origin_px[1] - scale_px_per_m * y_m
image_registration.estimation_method: Read from the plotted marker centres of S1, S2, S5 and S8, which the source tables also give numerically. Agreement between the X-derived and Y-derived scale was better than 0.1%.
image_registration.operator_note: If overlay markers sit visibly off their printed dots, refine origin_px and scale_px_per_m here. Nothing else depends on these numbers.
